question: Is Pi_PI E_diag canonical from an already declared algebraic structure?

diagonalExpectation.status: canonical once the vertex diagonal MASA is declared

selectedReturnMap.formula: F_PI(a)=q E_diag(a) q=p_I a p_I+p_P a p_P
selectedReturnMap.status: canonical CP corner map only after q is supplied; not a full-algebra conditional expectation that derives q

pathSubalgebras.counterexample: E_IP E_PN=E_IN, an open length-two matrix unit outside the degree-one span
pathSubalgebras.blockExpectationUsingQ: a mapsto q a q+(1-q)a(1-q) is unital CP and bimodular, but presupposes q and retains the entire N-Z-X block

automorphismClassification.conclusion: unmarked symmetry excludes Pi_PI, while marking P or I destroys the reflection and makes every mask invariant; uniqueness follows only after adding the rule 'take the minimal mask containing both anchors'

alreadyNamedData: P is the selected cofactor role
I carries the complementary image mass d
I--P is the first primitive chain edge
anchorAudit.whatTheyDetermine: the labeled vertices and anchor edge
anchorAudit.whatTheyDoNotDetermine: a conditional expectation must discard every return at N,Z,X
anchorAudit.geodesicHullCandidate: the graph-convex hull of I and P is {I,P}
anchorAudit.geodesicHullRuleStatus: new functorial rule, not a consequence of J, grading, relation parity, or the spectral triple axioms
anchorAudit.restatementTest: declaring q=p_I+p_P or demanding exactly the A,d diagonal support is equivalent to supplying the desired return mask

spectralPolynomialAudit.universalMaskCondition: zero diagonal at N,Z,X for all nonzero edge weights
spectralPolynomialAudit.reason: the X diagonal is c0+c2*h^2; varying h forces c0=c2=0
spectralPolynomialAudit.spectralActionTrace: Tr f(D/Lambda) is a global scalar and Tr D^2 sums returns at all vertices
spectralPolynomialAudit.localizedSpectralAction: Tr(q f(D/Lambda)) produces a selected density but inserts q
spectralPolynomialAudit.heatKernel: exp(-t D^2) is positive definite for t>0, so every diagonal entry is strictly positive and no proper vertex mask occurs
spectralPolynomialAudit.heatKernelWithInsertion: q exp(-t D^2) q has the requested support only because q is inserted
spectralPolynomialAudit.status: no scalar spectral-action or heat-kernel polynomial generates Pi_PI

decision.smallestAdditionalAxiom: take the graph-convex/inclusion-minimal return corner containing the marked I--P anchor edge
decision.axiomCost: equivalent to supplying q=p_I+p_P; it is a useful concise rule but not a derivation of the texture
decision.strongestConclusion: the diagonal conditional expectation is canonical, whereas the selected endpoint corner is genuinely new marked-projector data

boundary: Canonicity is tested against automorphisms of the labeled/unlabeled five-chain, the declared diagonal and path algebras, J/grade/relation equivariance, and scalar spectral/heat-kernel functional calculus. A larger sourced algebra with a central projection equal to q could change the conclusion, but no such projection has been declared.
